$comment: The assistant's tools (src/ai/tools, src/ai/planner): previews, what the app reported back, facts' labels, notes and problems. Loaded with the assistant's chunk (I18n.extend). Simulations are integrated ahead, never a forecast.
ai.tool.problem.type: Should be {expected, select, object {an object} array {a list} string {text} number {a number} integer {a whole number} boolean {true or false} other {{expected}}}.
ai.tool.problem.additional: Not an argument of this tool.
ai.tool.problem.enum: Should be one of: {allowed}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}}.
ai.tool.problem.anyOf: Fits none of the {forms, number} forms this can take.
ai.tool.film.open.preview: Open {chapter} of the film{at, plural, =0 {} other {, {t, number} seconds in}}.
ai.tool.film.open.observed: The film is at {chapter}, {t, number} seconds in.
ai.tool.film.open.notSeen: Asked the film for {chapter}; it has not shown it yet.
ai.tool.film.notBuilt: {chapter} is not in the film yet.
ai.tool.film.control.preview: {action, select, play {Play the film} pause {Pause the film} next {Go to the next chapter} previous {Go to the previous chapter} explore {Switch to Explore Mode} film {Leave Explore Mode for the film} other {Change the film}}.
ai.tool.film.control.observed: The film is at {chapter}, {paused, plural, =0 {playing} other {paused}}.
ai.tool.film.control.notSeen: Asked the film to change; it has not shown it yet.
ai.tool.film.moment.preview: Show the moment “{point}” in Explore Mode.
ai.tool.film.moment.observed: Explore Mode shows “{title}”: {kind, select, measured {measured data} model {a scientific model} illustration {an illustration} other {a moment of the chapter}}.
ai.tool.film.moment.notSeen: Asked Explore Mode for “{title}”; it has not shown it yet.
ai.tool.film.moment.unknown: This chapter has no such moment. Its moments: {allowed}.
ai.tool.explorer.open.preview: Open the solar-system explorer{on, plural, =0 {} other { on {body}}}.
ai.tool.explorer.open.notSeen: The explorer has not come on screen yet.
ai.tool.explorer.close.preview: Leave the explorer for the film.
ai.tool.explorer.close.notSeen: The explorer has not closed yet.
ai.tool.explorer.fly.observed: {travelling, plural, =0 {The camera is at {body}.} other {On the way to {body}.}}
ai.tool.explorer.fly.notSeen: Asked to fly to {body}; the explorer has not turned to it yet.
ai.tool.explorer.fly.gone: {body} is no longer in this experiment.
ai.tool.explorer.place.preview: {named, plural, =0 {Go to latitude {lat, number}, longitude {lon, number} on the Earth.} other {Go to {place} on the Earth.}}
ai.tool.explorer.place.observed: Over latitude {lat, number}, longitude {lon, number}, with about {viewKm, number} km of ground in view.
ai.tool.explorer.place.notSeen: Asked to go to latitude {lat, number}, longitude {lon, number}; the view has not arrived yet.
ai.tool.explorer.place.both: Give a place, or latitude and longitude: not both.
ai.tool.explorer.place.which: Say where: a place, or latitude and longitude.
ai.tool.explorer.sky.preview: {on, plural, =0 {Hide} other {Show}} the sky’s {layer, select, constellations {constellation figures} boundaries {constellation boundaries} grid {grid} names {star names} other {layer}}.
ai.tool.explorer.sky.observed: The sky’s {layer, select, constellations {constellation figures} boundaries {constellation boundaries} grid {grid} names {star names} other {layer}}: {on, plural, =0 {hidden} other {shown}}.
ai.tool.explorer.sky.notSeen: The sky has not shown the change yet.
ai.tool.explorer.stars.preview: Go out among the stars around the Sun.
ai.tool.explorer.stars.observed: Among the stars around the Sun.
ai.tool.explorer.stars.notSeen: The view among the stars has not come up yet.
ai.tool.explorer.findStar.preview: Find the star “{name}” and fly to it.
ai.tool.explorer.findStar.observed: At {name}{known, plural, =0 {} other {, {distPc, number} parsecs from the Sun}}.
ai.tool.explorer.findStar.notPlaced: {name} was found, but has no place to fly to.
ai.tool.explorer.walk.preview: {here, plural, =0 {Walk on {world} at {named, plural, =0 {latitude {lat, number}, longitude {lon, number}} other {{place}}}.} other {Walk on the ground below the camera.}}
ai.tool.explorer.walk.observed: {landing, plural, =0 {Walking} other {Landing}} on {world} at latitude {lat, number}, longitude {lon, number}.
ai.tool.explorer.walk.notSeen: The walk on {world} has not begun yet.
ai.tool.explorer.walk.makkah: No walk begins within {km, number} km of the Kaaba: Makkah is seen only as a city in its valley.
ai.tool.explorer.walk.noGround: There is no ground to walk on below the camera here: give a place.
ai.tool.explorer.walk.placeOnEarth: The field notes’ places are on the Earth.
ai.tool.explorer.walkEnd.observed: Back to the view from above.
ai.tool.explorer.walkEnd.notSeen: The walk has not ended yet.
ai.tool.time.control.preview: {action, select, pause {Pause the clock} play {Run the clock} faster {Run the clock one step faster} slower {Run the clock one step slower} reverse {Run the clock the other way} now {Go back to now, at real time} other {Change the clock}}.
ai.tool.time.control.observed: The clock {paused, plural, =0 {runs at {rate, number} seconds a second} other {is paused}}; the date shown is {date}.
ai.tool.time.control.notSeen: The clock has not shown the change yet.
ai.tool.time.notInLab: In the laboratory the clock pauses, runs and changes speed, forwards only.
ai.tool.time.date.notSeen: Asked for {date}; the clock has not shown it yet.
ai.tool.time.date.invalid: Not a date: write it as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (UTC).
ai.tool.time.date.outside: The explorer’s data covers {start} to {end}; that date is outside it.
ai.tool.time.rate.preview: Run the clock at {rate, number} seconds a second.
ai.tool.time.rate.observed: The clock runs at {rate, number} seconds a second.
ai.tool.time.rate.notSeen: The clock has not shown the new rate yet.
ai.tool.time.rate.ladder: The clock’s rates are {allowed} seconds a second (negative runs it backwards).
ai.tool.islamic.where: Say where: a place, or latitude and longitude.
ai.tool.islamic.note: Worked out from the explorer’s own data, for learning: a great-circle direction from true north. For prayer, follow your local mosque.
ai.tool.islamic.qibla.observed: The qibla from {place}: {bearing, number}° from true north.
ai.tool.islamic.prayer.preview: Work out the times of prayer at {place} by the {convention} convention.
ai.tool.islamic.prayer.observed: The times of prayer at {place} on {date}, by the convention of the {convention}, in UTC.
ai.tool.islamic.prayer.note: In UTC, for sea level and to the minute, worked out for learning; the conventions as described here await a scholar’s review. Timetables usually add a minute or more to Dhuhr, and where the Sun does not go far enough below the horizon communities follow further rules. For prayer, follow your community’s own timetable.
ai.tool.convention.tehran: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
ai.tool.convention.russia: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia
ai.tool.islamic.crescent.preview: Work out whether the new crescent can be seen from {place}.
ai.tool.islamic.crescent.conjunction: New moon (the Moon passing the Sun), UTC
ai.tool.islamic.crescent.observed: The new crescent from {place}, by Yallop’s and Odeh’s tests.
ai.tool.islamic.crescent.note: What the sky allows by two published tests (Yallop 1997; Odeh 2004), worked out for learning. Communities begin each month by their own practice: by sighting, or by a calendar.
ai.tool.islamic.crescent.none: No new moon was found near that date in the explorer’s data.
ai.tool.crescent.none.moon-sets-first: The Moon sets before the Sun
ai.tool.crescent.none.high-latitude: Beyond the latitudes the test was made for
ai.tool.islamic.hijri.preview: Find the date in the Umm al-Qura calendar.
ai.tool.islamic.hijri.note: Umm al-Qura is Saudi Arabia’s civil Hijri calendar, computed in advance. Many communities begin each month by sighting the crescent, so their date can differ by a day.
ai.tool.islamic.hijri.unavailable: This browser does not have the Umm al-Qura calendar.
ai.tool.calc.twoBody: Kepler’s third law for two bodies alone: the pulls of other bodies change a real orbit a little.
ai.tool.calc.period.needA: Give the orbit’s semi-major axis (aKm) and what it goes round; only a planet’s own is known.
ai.tool.calc.escape_speed.preview: Work out the escape speed from {body}{altitudeKm, plural, =0 {’s surface} other {, {altitudeKm, number} km above its surface}}.
ai.tool.calc.escape_speed.value: Escape speed from {body}{altitudeKm, plural, =0 {’s surface} other {, {altitudeKm, number} km up}}
ai.tool.calc.circular_speed.preview: Work out the speed of a circular orbit {altitudeKm, plural, =0 {skimming {body}} other {{altitudeKm, number} km above {body}}}.
ai.tool.calc.circular_speed.value: Speed of a circular orbit {altitudeKm, plural, =0 {skimming {body}} other {{altitudeKm, number} km above {body}}}
ai.tool.calc.circular_speed.observed: A circular orbit about {body} there goes at {speed, number} km/s.
ai.tool.calc.orbital_period.preview: Work out the period of an orbit about {primary}.
ai.tool.calc.light_time.preview: {pair, plural, =0 {Work out how long light takes over that distance.} other {Work out how long light takes from {from} to {to}.}}
ai.tool.calc.light_time.distance: From {from} to {to} on {date}, centre to centre
ai.tool.calc.light_time.speed: The speed of light (exact, by the definition of the metre)
ai.tool.calc.light_time.which: Give two worlds (from and to), or distanceKm, or distanceAu: one of them.
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.preview: {pair, plural, =0 {Work out a Hohmann transfer between those orbits.} other {Work out a Hohmann transfer from {from}’s orbit to {to}’s.}}
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.total: Change of speed, both burns together
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.observed: A Hohmann transfer: {total, number} km/s in all, {days, number} days on the way.
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.note: Between round orbits in one plane, about the primary alone: a real mission also climbs out of one world’s gravity and into the other’s, and the planets’ orbits are tilted and a little oval.
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.which: For each end give a planet or a radius in km (fromKm, toKm), not both.
ai.tool.calc.hohmann.planet: A planet’s orbit is about the Sun: for orbits about another body give radii in km.
ai.tool.calc.roche.preview: Work out the Roche limits of {primary}.
ai.tool.calc.roche.fluid: Roche limit for a fluid satellite
ai.tool.calc.roche.rigid: Roche limit for a rigid satellite
ai.tool.calc.roche.observed: Roche limits: {fluid, number} km for a fluid satellite, {rigid, number} km for a rigid one, from the centre.
ai.tool.calc.roche.note: Measured from the primary’s centre. Inside the fluid limit a satellite held together only by its own gravity is pulled apart; real moons also have strength.
ai.tool.calc.roche.which: Give a satellite world or satelliteDensity: one of them.
ai.tool.calc.hill.preview: Work out the Hill radius of {body}.
ai.tool.calc.hill.observed: The Hill radius of {body}: about {km, number} km.
ai.tool.calc.hill.sun: The Sun goes round nothing heavier here: it has no Hill radius in the solar system.
ai.tool.calc.impact.preview: Work out what a body {diameterKm, number} km across striking {target} at {speedKmS, number} km/s does.
ai.tool.calc.impact.megatons: The same in megatonnes of TNT
ai.tool.calc.impact.regime: Outcome, by Leinhardt and Stewart’s regimes
ai.tool.calc.impact.giant: A giant impact: the target is reshaped, not cratered.
ai.tool.calc.impact.noSurface: A giant of gas and ice, or a star: there is no solid surface to crater.
ai.tool.calc.impact.note: Scaling laws for rock struck by rock (Collins, Melosh and Marcus, 2005), with a stony impactor of 3,000 kg/m³ unless another density is given: a model, not a measurement.
ai.tool.calc.impact.slow: Nothing falling from space strikes slower than the target’s escape speed.
ai.tool.calc.impact.observed: {known, plural, =0 {An impact on {target}.} other {An impact on {target}: a crater about {crater, number} km across.}}
ai.tool.regime.hit-and-run: hit and run (the impactor passes on)
ai.tool.calc.world_facts.observed: Facts about {body}, from JPL and NAIF.
ai.tool.calc.world.gravityMs2: Gravity at the equator or surface of {body}
ai.tool.cite.verse.unavailable: Verse {key} is not in the app’s verified text.
ai.tool.cite.hadith.preview: Show the reference and grading of hadith {id}.
ai.tool.cite.hadith.note: Shown by its reference and grading only: its wording has not been entered and reviewed.
ai.tool.cite.hadith.unavailable: That hadith is not among the app’s references.
ai.tool.cite.constant.unknown: There is no measured value {id} in the app’s data.
ai.tool.cite.source.title: Title
ai.tool.cite.source.author: Author
ai.tool.cite.source.unknown: There is no source {id} in the app’s data.
ai.tool.search.preview: Search the app’s verified content for “{query}”.
ai.tool.search.observed: {count, plural, one {One passage} other {# passages}} found for “{query}”.
ai.tool.search.none: Nothing in the app’s verified content matched “{query}”.
ai.tool.lab.open.preview: Open the orbital laboratory{seed, select, two { with two bodies} three { with three bodies} other { on a copy of the solar system}}.
ai.tool.lab.open.observed: The laboratory is open, with {bodies, number} bodies.
ai.tool.lab.open.notSeen: The laboratory has not come on screen yet.
ai.tool.lab.state.drift: Relative energy drift since the last edit
ai.tool.lab.state.observed: The laboratory: {bodies, number} bodies, {days, number} days integrated.
ai.tool.lab.experiment.notSeen: Sent, but the laboratory has not shown it yet: {sentence}
ai.tool.experiment.scale-mass.preview: Multiply {body}’s mass by {factor, number}, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.remove-body.preview: Take {body} out of the experiment, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.kick-body.preview: Change {body}’s speed by {dvKmS, number} km/s {way, select, prograde {along its motion} retrograde {against its motion} radialOut {away from what it goes round} radialIn {toward what it goes round} other {}}, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.impact.preview: Send a stony body {diameterKm, number} km across into {target} at {speedKmS, number} km/s, {angleDeg, number}° from the horizontal, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.add-moon.preview: Add a moon of {massKg, number, ::scientific} kg on a round orbit {distanceKm, number} km from the centre of {host}, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.second-star.preview: Add a second star of {massSun, number} solar masses on a round orbit {distanceAu, number} au out, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.change-orbit.preview: Give {body} an orbit {aFactor, number} times as wide, with eccentricity {e, number}, then integrate {days, number} days ahead.
ai.tool.experiment.notFor: Not a number this one ({experiment}) takes.
ai.tool.experiment.range: Should be from {min, number} to {max, number}.
ai.tool.experiment.zero: A kick of nothing changes nothing: give a speed.
ai.tool.experiment.noBody: There is no body “{body}” here. The bodies: {allowed}.
ai.tool.experiment.persistent: {body} lights the scene and stays in every experiment.
ai.tool.experiment.slow: Nothing falling from space strikes it slower than its escape speed, {min, number} km/s.
ai.tool.experiment.tooHeavy: At most half the host’s mass: {max, number, ::scientific} kg.
ai.tool.experiment.tooClose: Too close: at least {min, number} km from the host’s centre.
ai.tool.experiment.tooFar: Too far to stay a moon: within {max, number} km (half its Hill radius).
ai.tool.experiment.needsState: This needs the laboratory’s full readings.
ai.tool.experiment.periapsis: That orbit would come within {km, number} km of the centre of what it goes round: inside it.
ai.tool.experiment.invalid: The laboratory would not accept that.
ai.tool.lab.undo.observed: Undone; {left, number} earlier edits can still be undone.
ai.tool.lab.undo.notSeen: The laboratory has not shown the undo yet.
ai.tool.lab.measure.notSeen: The laboratory has not shown the measurement yet.
ai.tool.lab.compare.energyBaseline: Relative energy error, as it is
ai.tool.lab.compare.energyVariant: Relative energy error, with the change
ai.tool.lab.compare.observed: Compared: {sentence} ({events, plural, =0 {no collisions or escapes} one {one collision or escape} other {# collisions and escapes}} in the run with the change).
ai.tool.lab.compare.note: Integrated ahead by the laboratory: a thought experiment in a simplified model, not a forecast.
ai.tool.lab.compare.noShare: The laboratory gave no copy of its scenario.
ai.tool.lab.compare.tooLarge: This experiment is too large to copy ({chars, number} characters).
ai.tool.lab.compare.unreadable: The laboratory’s scenario could not be read: {detail}
ai.tool.compare.row.distance: {body}: distance from what it goes round, at the end
ai.tool.compare.event.fragment: {absorbed} struck {survivor} and both broke up after {days, number} days.
ai.tool.compare.event.disrupt: {absorbed} was torn apart by the tides of {survivor} after {days, number} days.
ai.tool.lab.optimise.preview: {goal, select, escape {In the background, find the smallest kick for {body} to escape within {days, number} days.} year {In the background, find the mass that makes the year of {body} {targetDays, number} days.} other {Search in the background.}}
ai.tool.lab.optimise.escape: Smallest kick along its motion for {body} to leave {primary} within {days, number} days
ai.tool.lab.optimise.year: Factor on the mass of {primary} for a year of {targetDays, number} days for {body}
ai.tool.lab.optimise.none: No answer in the range searched ({runs, number} runs).
